g.text: u've been holding out on me!!
i saw u stomping around in the giant spooky mech!!
is everything creepy in the future?
Not everything. Just stuff that the Entrati family deals with.
and i was so excited for a big cool mechsuit :(
should have known entrati had something to do w/ that thing
is there a version that comes without an ugly gross skull stuck to the front?
i can't even enjoy a big cool mechsuit without him ruining it :(
Now that you mention it, I don't know what the skull *does.* But it has to be important.
Different Entrati, but I get your point.
Well, these were Father Entrati's creations, not Albrecht's, to be fair.
mebbe i can start working on my own. design my own aoimech
whoaaaaa one of them was a priest?!?!?!
excuse me? u don't know what it does?
LOL. No. Very much not a priest. It's a long story.
its just not for me, u know?
have it play music while it fights
Someone gives me a big gun, I use the big gun. I don't get paid to ask questions.
Well, every single necramech I've ever seen has one.
So it has to be functional. Right?
That sounds like a great project.
what do u think happens if u... take it off?
don't worry, i've made sooo many crazier projects than that
it'll be fun!! even if it never works
well, i want a big stompy mech without a skull, i think that'd be fun
I don't think I want to find out, do you?
Maybe it tries to find another skull...
u should've seen the stuff i used to build in my garage when i was a kid
i promise if i gas it up i'll make sure to test it outdoors in case it explodes <3
nope! let's leave it right where it is thx
i'll just start working on my own instead
